scope: Seven read endpoints, six history cases across fresh processes, exact synthetic database contents and full live Klippy subscriptions. This is not an exhaustive API behavior audit.

identity_and_capabilities_kept.reason: Phobos retains API 1.5.0 and software identity phobos. The older Forge-X Moonraker reports API 1.4.0 and unknown software version. Matching that older identity would misrepresent the implementation.
The documented Python stub is retained. Other system-info values match inside the Forge-X chroot. Phobos does not impersonate CPython 3.11.10.

The minimal probe config exposes 25 phobos components versus 23 Moonraker components. Phobos retains update_manager and octoprint_compat. No update remotes are configured. This does not describe the full production configuration.
Phobos reports supported defaults not read or reported by the older Forge-X Moonraker. Their implementations remain intact.

The timeout is the same JSON number, serialized as 20 versus 20.0. Whitespace, number formatting and identity/default fields also change response lengths. Measurements use the bytes each server actually delivers.

intentional_policy_kept.reason: Phobos hides the forbidden authorized_users namespace name. The older Forge-X lists it. Credential reads remain forbidden; namespace ordering is immaterial.

environment.reason: Moonraker warns that its private config directory differs from Klippy's /opt/config. Phobos with validation disabled has no warning. The private probe directories protect production.
The minimal probe config exposes 268 objects, including six pins hidden by the production Fluidd configuration. Every backend returns all requested probe objects.

matching_reads: history pages, offsets, ordering and time filters
outside_this_capture: CAN empty-list fallback, optional components absent from Forge-X, no-op reboot/shutdown and excluded full Jinja2, LDAP and Apprise remain unchanged. They were not retested by this benchmark. Continuous status-flood cost, uploads, printing and long soaks are not measured.
